fact: The Ministry of Public Health's DHIS2 maturity assessment, reported in April 2022, states that a nationwide generic HMIS is in place in DHIS2 with data entry at the facility level, in a system of 197 health districts and 6,200 health facilities.
title: DHIS2 Operational Plan 2022 - 2024
publisher: Ministry of Public Health, Republic of Cameroon
